headline: [Spy Row!] Denmark Expels Russian Attaché Over Alleged [Plot to Kill Rapper]
caption:
🇩🇰 Spy Row! Denmark Expels Russian Attaché Over Alleged Plot to Kill Rapper

Denmark said on Friday it will expel Russia's defence attaché. Danish intelligence (PET) says Russian intelligence services planned an attempt to kill Ukrainian-American rapper Kyivstoner at a concert near Copenhagen on 25 September. Police stopped the suspects before the concert.

🔹 Guns and knives were found in the suspects' car. Two people have been charged with attempted murder and helping a foreign intelligence service. Both have pleaded not guilty, local media report.
🔹 Foreign Minister Lars Lokke Rasmussen said the attaché must leave Denmark within seven days. Denmark is not cutting diplomatic ties with Russia.
🔹 The Russian embassy called the claims "unsubstantiated" and said Denmark gave no evidence. Russian state media say Moscow will respond.

💬 How should Europe respond to claims like this? 👇

Sources: BBC, CNN, Reuters

headline: [Third Night!] Saudi Arabia Intercepts [3 Houthi Missiles] Fired at Riyadh
sub: Houthis threaten Saudi ports and power station
caption:
🇸🇦 Third Night! Saudi Arabia Intercepts 3 Houthi Missiles Fired at Riyadh

The Saudi-led coalition said its air defences shot down three ballistic missiles fired by Yemen's Houthi rebels towards Riyadh early on Saturday. Witnesses heard two explosions in the capital. No damage or injuries were reported from this attack.

🔹 It was the third night in a row that emergency alerts were issued for Riyadh. Two days earlier, a Houthi strike damaged a tower in Riyadh's financial district; no injuries were reported.
🔹 On Friday, the coalition struck Houthi targets at Yemen's Hodeidah port and in Sanaa. The Houthis then threatened Saudi Red Sea ports including Jeddah, a power station and Riyadh's financial centre.
🔹 The UN says it is following the escalation "with concern".

💬 Do you think talks can stop this conflict from growing? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera, AFP, Arab News

headline: [Overtime!] COP31 Climate Talks Run Late as [Fossil Fuels] Vanish From Draft
sub: A third draft is expected on Saturday
caption:
🌍 Overtime! COP31 Climate Talks Run Late as Fossil Fuels Vanish From Draft

The UN climate summit COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, was due to end on Friday but went into overtime. Nearly 200 countries are still stuck on the final deal. The latest draft does not mention fossil fuels at all, after Saudi Arabia and other big oil and gas producers objected.

🔹 Panama and about a dozen other countries demanded "a clear transition away from fossil fuels" and threatened to object. The EU said the draft "risks turning this climate COP into a fossil summit".
🔹 The new draft also dropped a target of $120 billion for poorer countries to adapt to climate change. At COP28 in Dubai in 2023, countries agreed to "transition away from fossil fuels".
🔹 COP31 President Murat Kurum said: "We are close to the finish line, but we are not there yet." A third draft is expected on Saturday.

💬 Should the final climate deal name fossil fuels? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera, AP

#GlobalEye #COP31 #ClimateChange #FossilFuels #Turkey #Climate
photo_needed: The COP31 climate summit venue or main hall in Antalya, Turkey (delegates, COP31 sign), or COP31 President Murat Kurum speaking, face clearly visible. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Double-Tap Strike!] Russian Missiles Hit Zelensky's Hometown, [7-Year-Old] Among Dead
sub: Rescue worker killed, 60 wounded in Kryvyi Rih
caption:
⚠️ Double-Tap Strike! Russian Missiles Hit Zelensky's Hometown, 7-Year-Old Among Dead

A Russian strike hit the centre of Kryvyi Rih, President Volodymyr Zelensky's hometown in central Ukraine, on Friday night. Ukrainian officials said a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old rescue worker were killed.

🔹 60 people were wounded, including six children, said regional head Oleksandr Hanzha.
🔹 Ukrainian authorities called it a "double-tap" attack: a second strike hit as emergency crews arrived at the scene.
🔹 City head Oleksandr Vilkul said about 25 apartment buildings, a hospital and schools were damaged.

💬 What should be done to protect rescue workers in war zones? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera
